title: Tidewatch launch film
voiceover: At low tide, you only need one answer: when's the water coming back? And out here, there's no signal. Tidewatch keeps that answer on your phone. Your favorite spots sit at the top, each with how far away it is. You get the next high water straight away: seven forty-eight, nine point four feet. A curve shows the whole day with a marker for now, and every high and low is listed. Now lose your signal. Nothing changes. The tide data is already on your phone, two years of it. Unlocking every station is four ninety-nine. You pay once. There's no account to make, and no ads to skip. So you can head out, tie off, and know when the water's coming back. Tidewatch. Know the water.
music: soft pad with a muted plucked bass and a brushed shaker, 92 BPM, calm and nautical, lifting for the last line; made without paid music
